capabilities: force notes to open and stay in reading mode
toggle forced reading mode via hotkey
toggle forced reading mode from the ribbon menu
extras: README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it must be installed manually from a release zip rather than through the community plugin browser.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian Plugin that forces reading mode, making it persistent.
problem: Obsidian does not keep reading mode persistent across notes or sessions, so notes reopen in edit mode when the user wants them in reading view.
summary: Plugin that forces Obsidian's reading mode to stay persistent, toggled via keyboard shortcut or ribbon menu item.
